messages:
linda: heads up — whole house Wi‑Fi just died. ISP says a squirrel chewed through the fiber outside. 😂 attaching photo, crew on the way.
ajay: omg nooo 😂 did they open a ticket? ETA on repairs?
linda: they already logged it, repair ETA ~2hrs. hotspot tethering for now. i might be offline for a bit if the phone dies, ping me for urgent pairing.
kevin: weird, i'm fine two blocks over so must be a local cut.
maria: pro tip for mac folks: System Preferences > Network > Wi‑Fi > Create Network... or just share iPhone hotspot.
sam: linux fallback (USB tether) works great. quick commands if anyone needs:
```bash
# plug phone via USB, then check and connect
nmcli device status
nmcli device connect usb0
```
infra-bot: Incident created: #net-outage-1801234567 — tagging oncall infra. Initial ETA 2h. Logged by linda.
ajay: :thumbsup: thanks for the heads up
maria: also big kudos to whoever managed to spot the squirrel and take a pic 🐿️
linda: photos: <https://files.redwood.ai/squirrel-fiber.jpg|squirrel-fiber.jpg>
kevin: should we get a spare UPS or maybe some outdoor rodent-proofing? lol
sam: if anyone needs me to cover slack or calls while linda is offline, DM and i'll jump in
linda: thanks everyone, i'll update when the crew finishes repairs. face_with_tears_of_joy:"
